anomalies.description: A red car on the right shoulder loses control, veers sharply left across the grassy embankment, and collides with a guardrail or barrier, kicking up dust/debris; the vehicle appears to flip or roll partially before coming to rest.

The dashcam vehicle collides with or is struck by another vehicle, causing violent upward camera motion and loss of forward view; the rearview mirror dominates the frame and the road disappears, consistent with a high-impact crash.
